chapter: Fats Waller, marriage and Indian school tours
title: Leaving Paris, meeting and marrying Ida
summary: Homesick, Moore left Paris, arrived broke, and married Ida, an Oneida who became a teacher.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: Well, let's move up into the '50s again. About in the mid-50s you took a big step in your life. You met Ida, your wife.

Yes, I had just come back -- outside of Paris, and it was close to Christmastime and in Paris they didn't have the Christmas spirit as I remembered the Christmas spirit in New York, Park Avenue all lit up with trees, all the tall buildings, beautiful scene in New York and I got homesick for New York and I dropped everything -- first of all -- I might say this first when I go for contracts to the different promoters who hire me to work, they wouldn't give me the money when I first came there, naturally, because you've They'd tell me, 'Monsieur Moore, / be here a long time, we paid you the money -- we paid you when

you first got here, you know. So in order to live like a Frenchman over there you have to accept what they give you, you can't dictate a price to them. So when that day came about when it was time for me to move on for that reason and another reason about the big Christmas time that I wanted to be home for Christmas -- I came home, but then -- easy come, easy go. I made a lot of money but I squandered it away on one thing or another and when I arrived back in New York I ran into my wife, Ida. When we got married I hocked everything that was in sight so we could fly to Illinois where she was -- her folks were there and we got married in Illinois.
She's also American Indian. What tribe is she?
Oh, yeah, she's from the Oneida tribe. I'm grateful to say I've got a good wife and a fine mother-in-law and we have a good rapport.
Well, she was teaching at the time?

Yes, when we first got married she didn't have anything to do because she'd clean house and cook and so forth and then probably got bored and wanted to do something constructive. She asked my permission, said she'd like to teach school because I
